answer: Mirror-audit signal watch: every identity's trading signal — counterparty mix, timing, volume — is mirrored to 5 random established auditors who compare it against the population baseline. New rights thaw glacier-slow: only 10% of full quota unlocks per clean epoch, so a fresh fake can barely trade for 10 epochs. A deviating signal freezes the identity and forfeits a 30-unit bond; 100 fakes need 3,000 units in bonds plus 1,000 genuinely varied trades to look real.
